title: CTK7A, a curcumin derivative, can be a potential candidate for targeting HIF-1alpha/p300 complex: Evidences from in vitro and computational studies.
authors: Rath, Suvasmita; Jena, Atala Bihari; Bhattacharyya, Asima; Dandapat, Jagneshwar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素衍生物CTK7A抑制HIF-1α/p300复合物互作，涉及蛋白-蛋白对接而非TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅分子对接与湿实验，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Hypoxia-inducible factor-1 (HIF-1) is a transcription factor which plays a critical role in several biochemical pathways, and consists of oxygen-dependent alpha (alpha) and a constitutively expressed beta (beta) subunit. Under hypoxic conditions, HIF-1alpha is stabilized and forms a complex with beta subunit and this complex is associated with cancer progression. HIF-1alpha activity is mainly regulated by its transcriptional co-activator p300 which has histone acetyl-transferase (HAT) activity. p300 HAT activity is very crucial for p300 auto-acetylation and subsequently its interaction with its partner molecule HIF-1alpha as well as proapoptotic protein p53. p300 is a multi-domain protein and CH1 domain of p300 is the interacting partner of the C-terminal domain (CTD) of HIF-1alpha as well as p53. Several p300 HAT inhibitors are reported to suppress p300 auto-acetylation which inhibits its interaction with associated partners. We demonstrated that the p300 HAT inhibitor CTK7A down-regulated p300 auto-acetylation, HIF-1alpha accumulation as well as activity in gastric cancer cell lines. Protein-protein interaction and molecular docking studies revealed a significant decrease in the binding energy of full-length p300 as well as p300-CH1 and HIF-1alpha-CTD complex in presence of CTK7A. Further, SwissADME, evaluates the drug-likeliness property of CTK7A by analyzing its lipophilicity, size, polarity, solubility, saturation, and flexibility. Our in vitro and in silico data support reduced HIF-1alpha-p300 interaction in the presence of CTK7A. Hence, CTK7A might be playing a crucial role in down-regulating HIF-1alpha activity and can be a prospective anticancer drug.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子-1（HIF-1）是一种转录因子，在多种生化途径中发挥关键作用，由氧依赖性α亚基和组成性表达的β亚基组成。在低氧条件下，HIF-1α被稳定化，并与β亚基形成复合物，该复合物与癌症进展相关。HIF-1α的活性主要受其转录共激活因子p300调控，p300具有组蛋白乙酰转移酶（HAT）活性。p300的HAT活性对p300自身乙酰化及其随后与其伙伴分子HIF-1α以及促凋亡蛋白p53的相互作用至关重要。p300是一个多结构域蛋白，其CH1结构域是HIF-1α C末端结构域（CTD）及p53的相互作用伙伴。据报道，多种p300 HAT抑制剂可抑制p300自身乙酰化，从而阻断其与相关伙伴的相互作用。我们证明，p300 HAT抑制剂CTK7A在胃癌细胞系中下调p300自身乙酰化、HIF-1α积累及其活性。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和分子对接研究表明，在CTK7A存在下，全长p300以及p300-CH1与HIF-1α-CTD复合物的结合能显著降低。此外，SwissADME通过分析CTK7A的亲脂性、大小、极性、溶解度、饱和度和柔韧性，评估其药物相似性特性。我们的体外和计算机模拟数据支持CTK7A存在下HIF-1α-p300相互作用减少。因此，CTK7A可能在下调HIF-1α活性中发挥关键作用，并可能成为一种有前景的抗癌药物。
